summary: Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Trust 2026-5C9 commercial mortgage pass-through certificates on May 28, 2026, under a pooling and servicing agreement dated May 1, 2026. The certificates include publicly offered classes sold to underwriters and privately offered classes sold to initial purchasers. This is a routine securitization of commercial mortgage loans, not a special situation. No special-situations elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activism, or restructuring are present. The filing is an ordinary current report for a structured finance issuance.
